name: Lycopodium Limited
summary: Lycopodium Limited provides engineering and project delivery services in the resources, rail infrastructure, and industrial processes sectors in Australia. It offers engineering and related services to the mining industry, including process plant and equipment, civil building works, control systems, services, and infrastructure, as well as engineering and related services to manufacturing and renewable energy facilities.
